fields.name: WHERE
fields.value:
Live tracker in **📢│announcements**
Trade bait in the **📣│trade-block** forum

fields.name: BEFORE YOU TRADE
fields.value: A trade must be fully processed in Fantrax before the deadline; one processed after it is reversed (11.6). A future 1st- or 2nd-round pick needs the seller's prepayment confirmed in **💰│league-ledger** first (Article XII).

fields.name: REMINDERS
fields.value: RSVP to this event in **📅│league-calendar** and Sesh sends you a reminder by direct message.
